_comment: Per-series TTS pronunciation overrides, applied by tts_generator.py to target-language lines only. These live with the series, not with a script, because scripts get regenerated. Each rule: {match, say, word?, whole_line?}. Chosen by ear — see README notes on why IPA rules are not used.

rules._why: Bare Latin letters give eleven_v3 nothing to go on and it reads them as English letter names. Swedish letter names spelled out phonetically.

A bare 'Tack.' comes out with a long vowel, colliding with 'tak'. A terminal '!' shortens it. Only on a line that is nothing but the word: in a phrase such as 'Ett kort a: tack.' the vowel is already short and plain is preferred.
